stays.name: Hotel Flor Tampa Downtown, Tapestry Collection by Hilton
stays.summary: The 1920s Floridan hotel tower at the north end of downtown, reopened in 2024 as a Tapestry Collection by Hilton hotel with 210 rooms, The Dan restaurant and event spaces including the Floridan Ballroom and the Crystal Ballroom.
stays.quote: Historic charm meets modern luxury

heritage.architect: G. A. Miller and Francis J. Kennard
heritage.story: Construction of the Hotel Floridan began in 1926 and it opened in 1927 with 19 floors and 316 rooms; it was Tampa's tallest building until 1966. Its Sapphire Room bar was a World War II nightspot for servicemen training at nearby Drew Field. The hotel closed to overnight guests in 1966 and shut in 1989. After a long restoration it reopened as the Floridan Palace Hotel in 2012, and in January 2024 it reopened as Hotel Flor Tampa Downtown, Tapestry Collection by Hilton.
heritage.visiting: Open as a hotel; The Dan restaurant and Cass Street Coffee Company are on site, per the hotel's site.

stays.notes: Hotel site (WebFetch): The Dan, Cass Street Coffee Company, 'Flor in the Morning' breakfast; dogs up to two per room, 50 lbs, $75 per stay; $30/day destination fee. stays.name: Le Méridien Tampa

stays.quote: This century-old Historic Federal Courthouse has been transformed into a one-of-a-kind Tampa hotel.

heritage.architect: James Knox Taylor (Supervising Architect of the U.S. Treasury)
heritage.story: The building was completed in 1905 under James Knox Taylor, Supervising Architect of the U.S. Treasury. It served as a federal courthouse for the Southern District of Florida and, after the Middle District was created in 1962, for the Middle District until 2001. It was listed on the National Register in 1974 as the Federal Building, U.S. Courthouse, Downtown Postal Station. The City of Tampa owns it, and it is now a Le Méridien hotel.

report:
# stays-tampa-core: report (researched 2026-09-27)

## Coverage

32 stay records in the City of Tampa core. By area: downtown-tampa 14 (incl. Pendry, not yet open), channel-district incl. Water Street 7, harbour-island 1, ybor-city 4 (incl. The Inn at El Reloj, not yet open), hyde-park incl. SoHo 2, south-tampa 2, tampa-heights 1, west-tampa 1 (The James Hotel, not yet open). No record for davis-islands or seminole-heights: no hotel, inn or B&B there could be confirmed as operating (see "Left out").

By kind: hotel 17, boutique-hotel 5, extended-stay 5 (Residence Inn, Hyatt House, Home2 Suites, ROOST, Mint House), historic-hotel 2 (Hotel Flor, the 1926-27 Floridan; Le Méridien, in the 1905 federal courthouse), inn 1, motel 1, hostel 1.

By status: 29 open (four with a status_note: Hotel Tampa Riverwalk is under renovation to Nov 30, 2026 with its pool and restaurant closed; the Tampa EDITION's rooftop pool, bar and Azure are closed to Oct 3, 2026; the Tahitian Inn's pool is closed and it has no working elevator; Gram's Place's own website is down), 3 opening-soon (The Inn at El Reloj, The James Hotel, Pendry Tampa).

Heritage blocks (5): Hotel Flor (NRHP 96000315, listed 1996 as the Floridan Hotel; architects G. A. Miller and Francis J. Kennard), Le Méridien Tampa (NRHP 74000633, listed 1974 as Federal Building, U.S. Courthouse, Downtown Postal Station; completed 1905 under Supervising Architect James Knox Taylor), and short sourced stories for Hotel Haya (rose from the Las Novedades facade), The Inn at El Reloj (1910 boarding house for cigar workers) and The James (former Balbin Bros. cigar factory).

## How candidates were found

1. Visit Tampa Bay accommodation listings, pulled through the site's listings API (category 5; regions Downtown/Channel District, South Tampa, Ybor City, and the other regions to check boundaries); every in-scope listing page then read in full (23 hotels in scope).
2. Tampa Downtown Partnership "Stay" directory (20 hotels) and its 2019 "11 places to stay" article (former names: Sheraton Tampa Riverwalk, Floridan Palace, Marriott Waterside).
3. Hilton's Tampa locations page (every Hilton-family hotel in the city).
4. OpenStreetMap via Photon: tourism=hotel|motel|guest_house|hostel inside a box around the core (86 features, incl. every motel on N Florida, N Nebraska and E Hillsborough avenues).
5. Water Street Tampa's Stay page; Visit Tampa Bay's new-development page (openings); Cvent's Tampa hotel-venue profiles (44 hotels bay-wide, 11 in scope) for hotel-supplied room counts and build years; booking.com district pages (Ybor City, Downtown) as a cross-check; hotelguides.com's Gandy Blvd list for South Tampa.
6. WebSearch for new openings, B&Bs, Seminole Heights, Tampa Heights, Ybor City and South Tampa hotels. The session's shared search budget ran out part-way, which limited follow-up on the South Tampa chains (below).

## Sources

The hotel's own site is source_url wherever it could be read (Barrymore, Hotel Tampa Riverwalk, Hotel Flor, Hotel Haya, Epicurean, Palihouse, Tampa EDITION, ROOST, Kasa for Mint House, Tahitian Inn, Hotel South Tampa, J.C. Newman for El Reloj, Pendry). marriott.com, hilton.com hotel pages, hyatt.com, ihg.com, choicehotels.com and bestwestern.com refuse automated reading (HTTP 403/503), and the Wayback Machine is blocked by the proxy, so for those chain hotels source_url is the hotel's own Visit Tampa Bay partner listing (hotel-supplied text, room counts and amenity flags), with the Cvent profile, Water Street Tampa or the managing company's opening release (HRI Hospitality for the two Hyatts) as also_sources. Each record's notes say which fact came from which page. features list only what a source states; free-breakfast only where it says complimentary breakfast. rooms come from the hotel's own page when stated, else its Visit Tampa Bay listing, cross-checked with Cvent where available (all 11 agree, after resolving the Westin to 309). opened is set only for the hotel's own opening (Cvent built year for new builds, the Hyatt release, SpringHill per Visit Tampa Bay, Tahitian Inn 1953) and left null where the building predates the current hotel. Quotes were checked character by character against the saved page text (WebFetch pages re-read with a verbatim prompt).

Coordinates: US Census geocoder on the street address for 26 records (exact address matches; Mint House matched 800 E Whiting St, the even side of the same block, noted), Photon/OSM building matches for JW Marriott, Tampa Marriott Water Street and ROOST. The three not-yet-open hotels have no published street address and no coordinates.

## Left out, and why

- Westshore/airport, Drew Park and stadium-area hotels, per the slice split: Holiday Inn Express & Suites Tampa Stadium (2055 N Dale Mabry, filed under Westshore/Airport by Visit Tampa Bay), the Tampa Stadium hotel at 4750 N Dale Mabry (Country Inn & Suites in OSM, "Express" on HotelPlanner), Econo Lodge Raymond James (4732 N Dale Mabry), Days Inn & Suites Raymond James Stadium (5405 N Church Ave). Flagged for the merge because SPEC places the stadium in west-tampa.
- East Tampa hotels named for Ybor: Holiday Inn Express & Suites Tampa East-Ybor City (2520 N 50th St), Days Inn & Suites Tampa near Ybor City (2905 N 50th St), Quality Inn & Suites Near Fairgrounds Ybor City, Rodeway Inn Near Ybor City-Casino (2904 Melbourne Blvd), Tampa 8 Inn (N 46th St): they sit on 50th St/I-4 in east-tampa (other slice).
- South Tampa chain hotels seen in OSM and on hotelguides.com but not verified, because their brand sites block reading and no reliable current page was found after search ran out: La Quinta Inn & Suites by Wyndham Tampa Bay Area-Tampa South (4620 W Gandy Blvd), TownePlace Suites Tampa South (4505 S Dale Mabry Hwy), Sleep Inn & Suites Tampa South (6231 S Dale Mabry Hwy), Best Western Tampa (734 S Dale Mabry Hwy), Quality Inn Airport-Cruise Port (1020 S Dale Mabry Hwy, OSM only). HotelPlanner pages exist for some but mix in another hotel's data, so they were not used. This is the main known gap.
- Budget motels in Tampa Heights and Seminole Heights on N Florida Ave, N Nebraska Ave and E Hillsborough Ave (OSM: Downtown Motel, Jayhawk, Oaks, Open Gate, Dutch, Alamo, Antigua, Casa Loma and Casa Loma #2, Columbia, El Rancho, Haven Inn, Mayflower, Oasis, Orange, Royal Palm, Swan, Seminole Motel) and Park Motel on W Kennedy Blvd: no official websites and no way to confirm they operate; several rent weekly.
- AVE Tampa Riverwalk (160 W Tyler St): furnished apartments for stays of 30 days or longer.
- Future hotels opening after the guide window or not yet begun: AC Hotel + Moxy Tampa Downtown (111 N Meridian Ave, early 2028), Hotel ORA (1101 E Jackson St, expected to break ground in 2026), the Magnolia Hotel on Bayshore (announced). Pendry Tampa is included as opening-soon ("Debuting in 2027").
- Closed or not hotels today: Don Vicente de Ybor Historic Inn (closed 2015), the Tampa Bay Hotel (UT's Plant Hall), the Palmerin Hotel and Old Union Depot Hotel (NRHP names only), MacDill Inn (military), Ronald McDonald House and Good Samaritan Inn, and vacation-rental homes on booking sites.

## Open questions for the verifier

1. Hotel Tampa Riverwalk: is it the "Curio Collection by Hilton on the Tampa Riverwalk" (281 rooms, late 2026) on Visit Tampa Bay's new-development page? Its own site does not say so; brand/collection may change after Nov 30, 2026.
2. Westin: Cvent and the marriott.com URL say "Westin Tampa Downtown Waterside"; Visit Tampa Bay still says "The Westin Tampa Waterside". The record uses the former; confirm on marriott.com.
3. Gram's Place: tampahostel.com shows a Wix domain error; Hostelworld still takes bookings with reviews through May 2026. Confirm it operates.
4. University Inn Downtown Tampa: only directory sources (Yellow Pages, Tampa Downtown Partnership); its listed website did not respond. Confirm it operates.
5. The James Hotel: no official page found; street number and brand (seen only in search snippets) were left out.
6. The Inn at El Reloj: no published street address or opening date.
7. Hotel Flor opening year: 1926 (hotel listing, Cvent) vs 1927 (Wikipedia); heritage.built is 1926–1927 and opened is null.
8. Amenity flags for Marriott, Hilton and Hyatt hotels come from their Visit Tampa Bay listings; please spot-check them on the brand pages in a browser, and add the unverified South Tampa chain hotels if they are open.
